requirement: A role whose opening brace is Markdown-escaped must remain unchanged.

inputs.contents:
#[test]
fn literal_markdown_contexts_remain_byte_identical() {
    let cases = [
        "```markdown
{req}`fake.id`
{missing.id}`reference`
```
",
        "~~~
{req}`fake.id`
~~~
",
        "    {req}`fake.id`

    {missing.id}`reference`
",
        "``{req}`fake.id` `` and ``{missing.id}`reference` ``
",
        "\{req}`fake.id` and \{missing.id}`reference`
",
        "[{req}`fake.id`](https://example.com)
",
        "![{req}`fake.id`](image.png)
",
        "[{missing.id}`reference`][target]

[target]: page.md
",
        "![{missing.id}`reference`][image]

[image]: image.png
",
    ];
    for source in cases {
        assert_eq!(render(source), source);
    }
    // An even number of backslashes escapes the slash, not the role brace.
    assert!(render("\\{req}`real.id`").starts_with("\\<a "));
}
